bluf: Pattern is a US global ecommerce accelerator, founded 2013, claiming the #1 third party Amazon seller spot globally, 77T+ ecommerce data points and reach in 100+ countries, selling marketplace growth, retail media and fulfillment to consumer brands. It sits on the platform side: Pi fixes ecommerce issues automatically, a free GEO Scorecard ranks brands in AI search, and 865 sitemap URLs moved in 90 days. Horus puts it in the Tailwind band at 38.9 with no headwind. A rival should know it sells creators and TikTok Shop with no Instagram, TikTok or YouTube channel linked from its own site, and that its India delivery footprint is observed.
doing:
Pattern positions as a global ecommerce accelerator helping brands win on Amazon, TikTok Shop and every marketplace through AI driven technology, fulfillment and expert strategy: it sells and ships brands' products on marketplaces and sells the software it runs on. The headline claim is the #1 third party Amazon seller globally, 77T+ ecommerce data points and reach in 100+ countries.

The sold mix leads with retail media, scored 3, on a title claiming the #1 global ecommerce accelerator and an H1 promising wins on every marketplace. Four core lines score 2: AI Automation on Pi, the homepage tool that fixes ecommerce issues automatically; AI Search / GEO on the free GEO Scorecard pages and Shopify app plus a ChatGPT ads offer; Creator & Influencer on a social commerce page with TikTok Shop and creators and news reporting the purchase of influencer firm Current; Data & Measurement on the Natura case crediting product level cross channel data for 37% higher TikTok ROAS. The service list adds brand discoverability, global expansion, brand and price control, recovery of Amazon reimbursements and brand and package design; the partner listed is Mirakl. Proprietary lines run to Pi, the GEO Scorecard, TrendVision, the PXM content platform, Pattern Intelligence, the Amazon Performance Scorecard and a Revenue = Traffic x Conversion x Price x Availability framework.

Its AI posture is a platform posture: Pi, the GEO Scorecard and ad reach into ChatGPT. Dated moves: a Fortune and Great Place to Work Best Workplace listing for 2023 and a Newsweek 2025 Excellence 1000 listing; the news index dates all eight items 2026-09-23 while their titles reach back to 2021. Pricing signals: recovery sold as hassle free and risk free with a free audit, and the GEO Scorecard free; no price shows. Conspicuously absent: ownership, headcount, any US office in the office list (only India is listed), and any own short form social channel.
clients:
The client type is mixed and the verticals are beauty and personal care, apparel, food and beverage, sporting goods and art supplies; the home market is the US, with India the one office listed and jobs posted in Lehi, UT, North Las Vegas, NV, Hebron, KY, Pune and London.

The needs read holds 22 clients, 9 with an observed need and 13 named only, from 5 case studies and 17 slugs. Commerce and marketplaces leads the mix with 4: Sakura (grew 5X on Amazon), Golf Pride (Amazon revenue up 62%), Steelcase (premium B2C growth on Amazon) and Pupford (FBA bottlenecks eliminated). Paid performance holds 4: Natura (TikTok ROAS up 37% with product level data), Sports Direct (CPA cut 33%), Flannels (ROAS up 107%) and Reserva (Meta ROAS up 17% with AI driven smart segments, also coded AI and automation). Social and creators holds 2: Natura again and MuscleTech (a TikTok Shop playbook at 200x GMV growth). Named only signals still describe work: Bird Buddy (no more peak season stockouts), Farm Rio with ROI Hunter (61% more conversions on Meta) and Gina Tricot (returns cut 14%). SPANX, BetterBody Foods, Wahl, Leatherman, Balance of Nature, Super Coffee, Zyliss, NaturVet, Feetures and Timeless Skin Care are names only, needs inferred from the marketplace lead.

Two clients are shared: Sports Direct also sits with journey-further and Gina Tricot with precis-digital.

What the base needs next: a marketplace book sits under KJ4 (the platforms are absorbing the execution layer), its Horus tailwind through data and retail media. It is very likely, high confidence, that these brands will keep buying marketplace execution from a party that also holds inventory and data, and likely, moderate confidence, that the TikTok Shop and creator accounts will ask why their agency has no creator channel of its own.
house: Say and do: two lines tested, one practised, integrity 50. AI search is corroborated: it publishes an llms.txt and its sitemap holds 9 AI topic URLs. Creator and influencer is contradicted: it sells TikTok Shop and creators and links no Instagram, TikTok or YouTube channel from its site. Own advertising: 204 Google ads in the Transparency Center, 79 in the last 30 days, last shown 2026-09-27, under five advertiser names; one sample reads 'Retail Media Optimisation | Cut wasted retail media spend and improve ROAS with AI optimisation. Book a call.' LinkedIn shows 24+ company page ads, a floor against 1,912 name matches, one saying last quarter's TikTok playbook is already dead and TrendVision shows what works. Content velocity is high: 1198 sitemap URLs, 865 updated in 90 days and 880 in 365. The house runs on Webflow with GTM and VWO; no social pixels, no ABM stack, no AI crawlers blocked. The Radar flagged no gaps.
market:
Horus puts Pattern at tailwind index 38.9, band Tailwind, 15:04 on the Solar Arc. Best placed for KJ4 (the platforms absorbing the execution layer, driven by Data & Measurement and Retail Media) and KJ6 (the agency middle hollowed out). The read lists no headwind. Best scenario fit: The Bazaar of Agents at 50/100. It is making P1 (a measurable AI visibility product) and P8 (ads inside assistants with holdouts), partial on P2 and P6, absent on P7; P3 and P4 do not apply and P5 is unknown.

The Monsoon read is 55.9, band Onshore wind, percentile 48: migration 66.4 well ahead of displacement 45.4. The sold mix supplies 42 of the index, Retail Media (8) and AI Search / GEO (7) carrying the most movable hours; the work would go 62% to South and Southeast Asia, 19% to Eastern Europe and 19% to Latin America. The footprint is observed, not inferred: a delivery footprint in Eastern Europe and South Asia, an India office and India jobs each adding 12 points, no onshore claim on record.
openings:
The strongest opening is the creator contradiction: it sells TikTok Shop, creators and social commerce, and its own site links no Instagram, TikTok or YouTube channel. A rival with a live creator channel and TikTok Shop results of its own can very likely (moderate confidence) win that comparison. Falsifier: a later compile finding short form channels linked from pattern.com closes it.

The second is the observed offshore footprint: an India office, a Pune advertising job and a Monsoon footprint in Eastern Europe and South Asia give an onshore delivery pitch something concrete to point at, though displacement 45.4 says the book does not buy on price, so the pitch is control and proximity, not rate. Sports Direct and Gina Tricot already sit on other tracked books and are the accounts to contest first. No public pricing (P5 unknown) beyond free audits and a free scorecard leaves an outcome priced offer unanswered. Do not contest the Amazon book on execution: with no Horus headwind and P1 and P8 making, the record shows no gap there, and it is unlikely, moderate confidence, that a service only rival takes a marketplace account from a party that also holds the inventory.
watch: I7, holiday 2026 agentic checkout volume and merchant opt out rates, December 2026 to January 2027: any disclosed AI checkout GMV strengthens the KJ4 tailwind it is best placed for, and high Shopify opt out rates would slow it.

I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures, October 2026: output or outcome pricing at a top five holdco would set a benchmark against a platform with free audits and no price on record.

I6, platform AI labeling enforcement after the EU Article 50(2) deadline, 2 December 2026: new reach penalties for unlabeled AI personas or engagement bear on KJ8 and on a creator line it sells without a channel of its own.

The Accelerate global ecommerce summit the news index announces: who speaks and which brands appear is the next client evidence, and the case pages modified through 2026-09-17 show the publishing machine is live.
The next Radar compile: this dossier is only as fresh as the 2026-09-28 compile; Google ads last shown 2026-09-27 and 865 sitemap URLs moved in 90 days, so this record will change fastest.
